top.sql_template: SELECT a.error_code,a.finished_at FROM job_attempts a JOIN jobs j ON j.owner_id=a.owner_id AND j.job_id=a.job_id WHERE a.owner_id=? AND j.task_type='?' AND ((a.error_code='?' AND a.finished_at>?) OR (a.error_code='?' AND a.finished_at>?)) ORDER BY julianday(a.finished_at)+CASE WHEN a.error_code='?' THEN 0.0208333333333333 ELSE 0.25 END DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT i.item_id,i.source_id,i.external_id,i.published_at,i.publication_provenance,i.discovered_at,i.availability,
        j.job_id,j.state job_state,j.reason_code,j.arrival_origin_at,j.origin_kind,j.attempt_count,j.due_at,j.input_revision,j.profile_revision,j.prompt_snapshot_id,
        (SELECT MIN(a.started_at) FROM job_attempts a JOIN jobs q ON q.owner_id=a.owner_id AND q.job_id=a.job_id WHERE q.owner_id=i.owner_id AND q.item_id=i.item_id AND q.task_type='?' AND json_extract(q.payload_json,'?')='?' AND json_type(q.payload_json,'?') IS NULL) analysis_started_at,
        ir.accepted_at accepted_complete_at,ir.run_id accepted_effect_id,
        sr.run_id source_run_id,sr.accepted_at source_accepted_at,sr.candidate_hash source_outcome_hash,
        json_extract(sr.outcome_json,'?') source_artifact_id,json_extract(sr.outcome_json,'?') source_hash,
        json_extract(sr.outcome_json,'?') source_language,json_extract(sr.outcome_json,'?') source_authority,
        ar.byte_size source_bytes
        FROM items i LEFT JOIN jobs j ON j.owner_id=i.owner_id AND j.job_id=(SELECT q.job_id FROM jobs q WHERE q.owner_id=i.owner_id AND q.item_id=i.item_id AND q.task_type IN ('?','?') AND (q.task_type!='?' OR json_extract(q.payload_json,'?')='?') AND json_type(q.payload_json,'?') IS NULL ORDER BY q.created_at DESC,q.job_id DESC LIMIT ?)
        LEFT JOIN analysis_runs ir ON ir.owner_id=i.owner_id AND ir.run_id=(SELECT r.run_id FROM analysis_runs r JOIN jobs q ON q.owner_id=r.owner_id AND q.job_id=r.job_id WHERE r.owner_id=i.owner_id AND r.item_id=i.item_id AND r.state='?' AND q.task_type='?' AND json_extract(r.outcome_json,'?')='?' AND json_extract(r.outcome_json,'?')=1 AND json_extract(r.outcome_json,'?')='?' ORDER BY r.accepted_at,r.run_id LIMIT 1)
        LEFT JOIN analysis_runs sr ON sr.owner_id=i.owner_id AND sr.run_id=(SELECT r.run_id FROM analysis_runs r JOIN jobs q ON q.owner_id=r.owner_id AND q.job_id=r.job_id WHERE r.owner_id=i.owner_id AND r.item_id=i.item_id AND r.state='?' AND q.task_type='?' AND json_extract(r.outcome_json,'?')='?' AND (ir.run_id IS NULL OR json_extract(r.outcome_json,'?')=json_extract(ir.outcome_json,'?')) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.run_id DESC LIMIT 1)
        LEFT JOIN artifacts ar ON ar.owner_id=i.owner_id AND ar.item_id=i.item_id AND ar.artifact_id=json_extract(sr.outcome_json,'?') AND ar.state='?' AND ar.kind='?'
        WHERE i.owner_id=? AND (? IS NULL OR i.item_id>?) ORDER BY i.item_id LIMIT ?

SELECT i.owner_id,i.source_id FROM items i JOIN item_revisions r ON r.owner_id=i.owner_id AND r.item_id=i.item_id AND r.revision_id=i.current_revision_id JOIN sources s ON s.owner_id=i.owner_id AND s.source_id=i.source_id WHERE s.enabled=1 AND r.fetched_at<=?
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jobs j WHERE j.owner_id=i.owner_id AND j.source_id=i.source_id AND j.task_type='?' AND json_extract(j.payload_json,'?')='?' AND j.state IN ('?','?','?','?','?')) ORDER BY r.fetched_at,i.item_id LIMIT ?
SELECT rowid AS __cursor,* FROM job_attempts WHERE rowid>? AND owner_id=? ORDER BY rowid LIMIT ?

SELECT w.owner_id,w.worker_id,w.scopes_json FROM worker_identities w
       JOIN owner_users u USING(owner_id)
       WHERE w.credential_hash=? AND w.revoked_at IS NULL AND u.allowlisted=1

  (routing_policy_version NOT IN ('?','?') OR ?='?')
  AND (routing_policy_version NOT IN ('?','?')

SELECT o.event_id,o.owner_id,o.payload_json FROM outbox o JOIN jobs j ON j.owner_id=o.owner_id AND j.job_id=o.job_id WHERE o.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.due_at<=? AND j.state='?' ORDER BY o.due_at,o.event_id LIMIT ?

SELECT i.owner_id,i.item_id,i.source_id,i.namespace,i.external_id,i.published_at,i.availability FROM items i JOIN sources s ON s.owner_id=i.owner_id AND s.source_id=i.source_id WHERE s.enabled=1 AND i.current_revision_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jobs j WHERE j.owner_id=i.owner_id AND j.item_id=i.item_id AND j.task_type='?' AND j.input_revision='?') ORDER BY i.discovered_at,i.item_id LIMIT ?

SELECT j.job_id,j.input_revision FROM jobs j JOIN analysis_runs r ON r.owner_id=j.owner_id AND r.run_id=j.input_revision JOIN jobs source ON source.owner_id=r.owner_id AND source.job_id=r.job_id WHERE j.owner_id=? AND j.task_type='?' AND j.state='?' AND j.due_at<=? AND j.routing_policy_version='?' AND j.profile_revision='?' AND json_extract(j.payload_json,'?')=r.run_id AND r.state='?' AND source.state='?' ORDER BY j.arrival_origin_at,j.job_id LIMIT ?

INSERT INTO worker_sessions(owner_id,worker_id,runtime,capabilities_json,heartbeat_at,online_until) SELECT owner_id,worker_id,?,scopes_json,?,? FROM worker_identities WHERE owner_id=? AND worker_id=? AND revoked_at IS NULL AND credential_hash=? ON CONFLICT(owner_id,worker_id) DO UPDATE SET runtime=excluded.runtime,capabilities_json=excluded.capabilities_json,heartbeat_at=excluded.heartbeat_at,online_until=excluded.online_until
SELECT rowid AS __cursor,* FROM artifact_chunks WHERE rowid>? AND owner_id=? ORDER BY rowid LIMIT ?
SELECT rowid AS __cursor,* FROM jobs WHERE rowid>? AND owner_id=? ORDER BY rowid LIMIT ?
SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE state IN ('?','?') AND due_at<=? ORDER BY due_at,job_id LIMIT ?

INSERT INTO jobs(job_id,owner_id,source_id,task_type,input_revision,profile_revision,routing_policy_version,explicit_run_nonce,dedup_key,state,due_at,priority,arrival_origin_at,origin_kind,payload_json,created_at,updated_at)
        SELECT ?,owner_id,source_id,?,?,'?','?','?',?,'?',?,?,?,'?',?,?,? FROM sources WHERE owner_id=? AND source_id=? AND enabled=1 AND due_at<=?
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE owner_id=? AND source_id=? AND task_type IN ('?','?') AND COALESCE(json_extract(payload_json,'?'),'?')=? AND state IN ('?','?','?','?','?')) ON CONFLICT(owner_id,dedup_key) DO NOTHING
SELECT rowid AS __cursor,* FROM outbox WHERE rowid>? AND owner_id=? ORDER BY rowid LIMIT ?

INSERT INTO jobs(job_id,owner_id,item_id,source_id,task_type,input_revision,profile_revision,routing_policy_version,explicit_run_nonce,dedup_key,state,reason_code,due_at,priority,arrival_origin_at,origin_kind,payload_json,created_at,updated_at)
        SELECT ?,owner_id,item_id,source_id,'?','?','?','?','?',?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'?',?,? FROM items WHERE owner_id=? AND source_id=? AND namespace=? AND external_id=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_scans s WHERE s.owner_id=? AND s.scan_id=? AND s.job_id=? AND s.commit_nonce=?) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jobs j JOIN worker_identities w ON w.owner_id=j.owner_id AND w.worker_id=j.lease_owner WHERE j.owner_id=? AND j.job_id=? AND j.task_type=? AND j.state='?' AND j.lease_owner=? AND j.fencing_token=? AND j.lease_until>? AND w.revoked_at IS NULL AND w.credential_hash=?)
        ON CONFLICT(owner_id,dedup_key) DO NOTHING
SELECT owner_id,job_id,fencing_token,task_type FROM jobs WHERE state='?' AND due_at<=? AND task_type NOT IN ('?','?') ORDER BY priority DESC,due_at,job_id LIMIT ?
SELECT table_name,MAX(chunk_index) last_index,SUM(count) rows,MAX(next_cursor) next_cursor FROM backup_chunks WHERE backup_id=? GROUP BY table_name
SELECT owner_id,job_id,fencing_token FROM jobs WHERE state IN ('?','?') AND lease_until<=? ORDER BY lease_until,job_id LIMIT ?
SELECT task_type,state,reason_code,COUNT(*) count FROM jobs GROUP BY task_type,state,reason_code
SELECT rowid AS __cursor,* FROM item_revisions WHERE rowid>? AND owner_id=? ORDER BY rowid LIMIT ?

SELECT knowledge_fts.rowid doc_rowid,d.doc_id,d.parent_id,d.item_id,d.run_id,d.kind,d.observation_id,d.entity_id,substr(d.text,1,1000) text,i.published_at,json_extract(m.metadata_json,'?') title
   FROM knowledge_fts JOIN search_documents d ON d.rowid=knowledge_fts.rowid
   LEFT JOIN items i ON i.owner_id=d.owner_id AND i.item_id=d.item_id LEFT JOIN item_revisions m ON m.owner_id=i.owner_id AND m.item_id=i.item_id AND m.revision_id=i.current_revision_id
   WHERE knowledge_fts MATCH ? AND d.owner_id=? AND (CASE d.kind WHEN '?' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM search_item_documents s WHERE s.owner_id=d.owner_id AND s.doc_id=d.parent_id) WHEN '?' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM search_observation_documents s WHERE s.owner_id=d.owner_id AND s.doc_id=d.parent_id) WHEN '?' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM search_insight_documents s WHERE s.owner_id=d.owner_id AND s.doc_id=d.parent_id) WHEN '?' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM search_entity_documents s WHERE s.owner_id=d.owner_id AND s.doc_id=d.parent_id) WHEN '?' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM search_alias_documents s WHERE s.owner_id=d.owner_id AND s.doc_id=d.parent_id) WHEN '?' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM search_summary_documents s WHERE s.owner_id=d.owner_id AND s.doc_id=d.parent_id) ELSE 0 END) AND (? IS NULL OR d.kind=?) AND (? IS NULL OR i.source_id=?)
   AND (? IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM item_spaces x JOIN spaces p ON p.owner_id=x.owner_id AND p.space_id=x.space_id AND p.active=1 WHERE x.owner_id=d.owner_id AND x.item_id=d.item_id AND x.space_id=? AND x.active=1))
   AND (? IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM entities e WHERE e.owner_id=d.owner_id AND e.entity_id=d.entity_id AND COALESCE((SELECT x.effective_entity_id FROM entity_identity_members x WHERE x.owner_id=e.owner_id AND x.entity_id=e.entity_id ORDER BY x.revision DESC LIMIT ?),e.entity_id)=(SELECT COALESCE((SELECT x.effective_entity_id FROM entity_identity_members x WHERE x.owner_id=t.owner_id AND x.entity_id=t.entity_id ORDER BY x.revision DESC LIMIT 1),t.entity_id) FROM entities t WHERE t.owner_id=d.owner_id AND t.entity_id=?)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM observation_entities e WHERE e.owner_id=d.owner_id AND e.observation_id=d.observation_id AND COALESCE((SELECT x.effective_entity_id FROM entity_identity_members x WHERE x.owner_id=e.owner_id AND x.entity_id=e.entity_id ORDER BY x.revision DESC LIMIT 1),e.entity_id)=(SELECT COALESCE((SELECT x.effective_entity_id FROM entity_identity_members x WHERE x.owner_id=t.owner_id AND x.entity_id=t.entity_id ORDER BY x.revision DESC LIMIT 1),t.entity_id) FROM entities t WHERE t.owner_id=d.owner_id AND t.entity_id=?)))
   AND knowledge_fts.rowid>? ORDER BY knowledge_fts.rowid LIMIT ?

UPDATE jobs SET state='?',lease_owner=?,lease_until=?,fencing_token=fencing_token+1,attempt_count=attempt_count+1,updated_at=?
        WHERE owner_id=? AND job_id=? AND task_type=? AND state='?' AND due_at<=?
        AND 
  (routing_policy_version NOT IN ('?','?') OR ?='?')
  AND (routing_policy_version NOT IN ('?','?')
    OR json_extract(payload_json,'?')=?)
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM worker_identities w WHERE w.owner_id=jobs.owner_id AND w.worker_id=? AND w.revoked_at IS NULL AND w.credential_hash=?) RETURNING job_id
